_note: Crew designations and the resources the habitat tracks. Edit and save; the station picks the change up within a couple of seconds. Order here is the order shown on the site. Four stores are tracked — drinking water, food rations, tampons and toilet paper (13 October: tampons and toilet paper took the places of the medical kits and the fire extinguishers). Their "start" is what is carried in — the drinking water 180 L, the food rations 35 days, the tampons 80 and the toilet paper 20 rolls (14 until 14 October) — and every gauge is drawn against it; "warnBelow" (the level a store turns orange at) ships as 0 — a placeholder, nothing invented. A store whose "start" is 0 and that has no count filed on the Habitat tab of mission control is shown as a placeholder rather than as an empty store. Correct the figures here before the run, or file the day-1 count on the Habitat tab: the site draws every gauge against the day-1 figure and carries it forward.
